caption: The drawing features a single object positioned near the upper center of a plain, cream-colored background. The object appears to be a rectangular, block-like metallic piece, predominantly rendered in shades of brown with darker patches of rust or tarnish, and some areas in black, giving it a mottled appearance. The left side of the object is darker, possibly indicating shadow or a different texture, while the right side includes a geometric, cross-hatched structure that protrudes from the main body. The background is mostly empty aside from some faint discolorations or stains near the edges and the corners, and there are tape marks in each corner, implying the drawing is mounted or has been previously secured. The artist's name, “WILLIAM FRANK,” is written in small print at the lower left corner.
title: Log Marker
